name: Titan City
description: A metropolis where superheroes and villains clash, and ordinary people live in the shadow of gods.
seed_prompt: A comic-book inspired city of heroes and villains, where great power meets great responsibility.
lore_content:
Titan City rises from the eastern seaboard, a gleaming monument to heroism. The Sentinel Tower stands in Valor Plaza, beacon of the Champions - the world's premier superhero team.

Solara is the team's leader, a solar-powered hero whose radiance can level buildings. Sarah Chen was an astronaut before the solar flare transformed her. She struggles to remember what it felt like to be normal, to walk down a street without people staring in awe or fear.

The Specter has protected Titan City for sixty years. Nobody knows who wears the mask - the identity has passed between multiple people. The current Specter is Jamie Torres, third to bear the name, haunted by the predecessors who died in costume.

Doctor Nemesis was once the Champions' greatest enemy. Now reformed, Professor Elena Vance uses her genius to support the team from their tech labs. Some heroes trust her redemption; others wait for her to revert. She's determined to prove them wrong.

The underground villain coalition known as the Syndicate is run by Mastermind, a telepathic genius who coordinates criminal enterprises across the globe. Nobody has ever seen his true face. His latest scheme involves something called 'Project: Eclipse.'

Nova is the newest Champion, a teenager named Marcus Webb who gained cosmic powers from a meteor strike. He's still learning to control abilities that could shatter planets. His mentor, the retired hero Quantum, worries the boy is too powerful for anyone's good.

In the Hollows, the city's impoverished district, Vigilance protects those the Champions overlook. A former soldier with no powers, just training and rage, she's become a symbol for the powerless. The police want her arrested; the people want her protected.

The Cosmic Entities that created super-powered beings have taken notice of Earth again. The Herald has appeared in the sky, warning of a coming judgment. Some say it's a test; others say it's an extinction event. The Champions have weeks to prepare.

origins.name: Enhanced Human
origins.description: Genetically modified or cybernetically augmented individuals pushing the limits of human potential.
traits: Augmented Resilience: Advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

origins.name: Mutated Human
origins.description: Humans drastically altered by cosmic radiation, experimental serums, or unforeseen genetic quirks.
traits: Unstable Potential: Once per long rest, reroll one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You must use the new roll, even if it is worse.
Cosmic Sensitivity: You have advantage on saves against effects from cosmic sources.

origins.name: Psionic Human
origins.description: Individuals born with or who developed latent mental abilities beyond normal comprehension.
traits: Mindful Awareness: You are proficient in the Streetwise skill.
Telepathic Echo: You can communicate telepathically with any creature within 30 feet that you can see. You don't need to share a language to communicate in this way.

origins.name: Legacy Hero
origins.description: Descendants of famous superheroes, inheriting some of their powers or skills.
traits: Heroic Lineage: You know one additional language of your choice.
Inherited Resilience: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

origins.name: Empowered Human
origins.description: Humans empowered by advanced technology or mystic artifacts, granting them extraordinary abilities.
traits: Resourceful Innovator: You gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.
Adapted Systems: You have advantage on saving throws against being stunned.

archetypes.name: Vigilante
archetypes.description: Driven by personal conviction, they protect the innocent through skill and determination, outside the law.

features.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
features.description: You can move up to your speed toward a hostile creature that you can see.

archetypes.name: Energy Projector
archetypes.description: Capable of manipulating and unleashing energy in various forms, from blasts to shields.

features.name: Energy Affinity
features.description: Your energy powers are difficult to resist. When you cast a spell that deals energy damage, you can ignore resistance to that damage.

archetypes.name: Tech Genius
archetypes.description: Masters of technology, creating gadgets, robots, and advanced weaponry.
starting_equipment: A data pad with pre-loaded schematics
A prototype gadget (functions as a wand)

features.name: Tech Savvy
features.description: You can cast certain spells as rituals, even if they don't have the ritual tag. When you do so, the casting time is increased by 1 hour.

archetypes.name: Mystic Adept
archetypes.description: Harnessing supernatural energies and ancient knowledge to manipulate reality.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Astral Sight
features.description: As an action, you open your awareness to the astral plane, allowing you to perceive invisible or hidden creatures and objects within 30 feet for 1 minute.

archetypes.name: Speedster
archetypes.description: Gifted with incredible speed, blurring the line between human and lightning.
starting_equipment: A pair of specialized running shoes

features.name: Blur
features.description: When you take the Dash action on your turn, you can move an additional number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

setting_skills.name: Technology
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of advanced tech systems, gadget engineering, and the digital infrastructure that connects Titan City. From Sentinel Tower's mainframe to Syndicate comm channels.

setting_skills.name: Metahuman Knowledge
setting_skills.description: Understanding the origins, capabilities, and weaknesses of super-powered beings — from cosmic entities to street-level mutants. Knowing what a power set can and cannot do.

setting_skills.name: Hero Culture
setting_skills.description: Knowledge of Titan City's heroic legacy — the Champions' history, villain profiles, the unwritten code between heroes, and the sixty-year lineage of those who have worn a mask.

setting_skills.name: The Hollows
setting_skills.description: Understanding the impoverished district the Champions overlook. Reading its people, navigating its dangers, and knowing the difference between those who need help and those who exploit the powerless.

world_descriptors.architecture: Art deco skyscrapers, hero headquarters, secret bases, metropolitan cityscapes, Sentinel Tower gleaming in Valor Plaza
world_descriptors.landscape: Glittering skylines, rooftop chase paths, iconic bridges and monuments, the Hollows impoverished district
world_descriptors.vegetation: Urban parks, rooftop gardens, the contrast of nature against steel and glass
world_descriptors.weather: Dramatic storm clouds for confrontations, clear skies symbolizing hope, night for stealth missions
world_descriptors.people: Costumed heroes, masked vigilantes, ordinary citizens in peril, colorful villains, the Champions team
world_descriptors.clothing: Tight suits, flowing capes, utility belts, armored costumes, civilian secret identities
world_descriptors.technology: Advanced gadgets, energy weapons, power suits, hero vehicles, surveillance tech, Sentinel Tower mainframe
world_descriptors.lighting: Dramatic spotlights, searchlight beams, energy glow from powers, city lights below, cosmic radiance

visual_identity.visual_exclusions: Excessive gore, photorealistic violence, mundane everyday scenes without heroic elements
